prediction_audit.scale: 0 = persistence; 1 = exact next token; negative = worse than persistence
prediction_audit.sensitivity_scale: ||pred(real order) - pred(another body's order)|| / ||pred(real order) - current token||: 0 = the order does not move the prediction, 1 = it moves it as far as the whole predicted change
prediction_audit.limitation: Encoded senses, not physical skill or held-out action-choice proof
prediction_audit.sampled_at: model steps whose number is a multiple of 20. The trainer latches a new command on model steps that are multiples of --motor-hold, and the command graded at model step s is the one sent during model step s-1, so with --motor-hold 5 every graded transition is the 5th and last model step of its command's hold, when the same command already fills the four newest context slots

arms.shuffled: another body's ABSOLUTE command (the absolute roll): body b's 26 x 9 command replaced by body b-1's as it stands (body 0 takes the last body's). Its targets are positions and orientations chosen for the other body's pose, so the change it asks of this body is larger than any body was asked, and a prediction that grows with the asked change errs more with it without using the command's effect. The original control: its keys keep their names and meaning (shuffled_action_mse, matched_prediction_mse, improvement_over_shuffled, sensitivity) and it is kept beside the size-matched arm for one segment, the first on this code, so the two can be read across; then it is retired
arms.size_matched: another body's command, SIZE-MATCHED: body b-1's command taken as a change from body b-1's own pose and applied to body b's pose (lem/model/contact_head.shuffled_order, the contact head's control: position = this pose + (other target - other pose) in cm, orientation = (other target x inverse of the other pose) x this pose, radius and strength as they stand) and the eyes' row as the other body's asked eye turn (its eye command minus its eyes' azimuth and elevation at the start) added to this body's eyes' angles (lem/model/efference.size_matched_other_order). Every asked move and turn is exactly the other body's, so a prediction that only grows with the size of the asked change scores the same with either command
arms.shifted_own: this body's OWN command shifted: each of its 26 x 9 numbers plus Gaussian noise of one standard deviation of that column over the executed-command stream (an exponential average over 2,000 model steps of every body's executed command, each quaternion taken with w >= 0, kept in LemLite._command_spread and saved in the episode companion; no gradient, never trained), each quaternion then rescaled to length 1. The noise of model step s comes from a generator seeded with the run's seed and s. Read only after 200 model steps of stream

prediction_audit.readings: improvement_over_<arm> = 1 - (sum of own-command prediction errors) / (sum of that arm's prediction errors) over the same transitions: 0 = the arm's command predicts as well as the own command, 1 = the own command predicts exactly where the arm's command does not, below 0 = the arm's command predicts better. sensitivity_<arm> = ||pred(own) - pred(arm)|| / ||pred(own) - current token||: 0 = the arm's command leaves the prediction where it was, 1 = it moves the prediction as far as the whole predicted change

scale.ratio: each body's token movement per unit of its own posture movement over the 300-s window (the token's and the posture's standard deviation over time, mean over numbers): 0 = the token does not move with the posture; the line = the live bodies' level
scale.ratio_posture_only: the same with the velocity and capacity inputs held at their window mean: the part that answers the posture (the lesson pushes this one)
scale.engaged: the bodies the lesson pushes: engaged when read under DEAF, released at LINE
scale.pushed_ever: the bodies the lesson has pushed since the start (the hold acts on these only)
scale.fatigue_line: the hold's line in force: the median fatigue answer on the posture-only rows of the judged bodies the lesson never pushed, read at the start and again each window (300 s) (null: no live body at the start, the hold does not act)
scale.fatigue_line_step: the step the hold's line was last read
scale.fatigue_answer_posture_only: the fatigue answer on the posture-only rows: every pushed body's at every step (the hold's reading), every moving body's on a gauge step
scale.hold_share_since_gauge: per body, the share of the steps since the last gauge step in which the hold pulled it down
scale.hold_any_share_since_gauge: the share of the steps since the last gauge step in which the hold acted on any body
scale.held: the pushed bodies whose posture-only fatigue answer read over the fatigue line (the hold pulled them down this step)
scale.hold: 1/2 x the sum of the held bodies' squared log excess over the fatigue line / bodies
scale.shortfall: ln line - ln ratio for a pushed body (0 at or above the line, or not engaged)
scale.jitter_share: the token's share of its own variance that changes between consecutive samples (0 = smooth, 1 = consecutive tokens unrelated)
scale.posture_jitter_share: the same share of the posture itself
scale.content: the version-4 posture content (a ten-block decoder's R2 at the penalty control_lambda): 0 = the token says nothing about the posture, 1 = exactly
scale.content_gain_matched: the same with the token's gain since the start divided out: a pure gain reads the start's content, movement without posture information less
scale.content_control: the same with the tokens shifted 150 s against the posture
scale.fatigue_answer: the token's mean change per number when every fatigue input moves by fatigue_step, over its response: 0 = the token ignores fatigue
scale.held_out: the window read through the encoder saved one window earlier (movement that encoder never trained on): its ratio and gain-matched content
scale.lesson_pace: each body's first-order change of ln ratio per update from the lesson's own step
scale.attributed: the lesson's summed first-order change of each body's ln ratio since the start
scale.start: the readings of the first full window, before the lesson's first update
scale.spread: the token's standard deviation over the 300-s window per number, mean over numbers: 0 = one token every moment
scale.posture_spread: the posture's standard deviation over the window per number, mean over numbers
scale.below_line: bodies pushed at the last step
scale.no_movement: bodies whose posture numbers did not change over the window (no ratio)
scale.applied: the lesson's gradient added after the clip, as a share of each encoder tensor's running gradient size; step_lr: the lesson's step per weight in learning rates

controls.shuffled: another body's ABSOLUTE command with this body's latent and pose: its targets as they stand, chosen for the other body's pose (the original control; kept beside size_matched for one segment, the first on this code, then retired; controllability's evidence gate in force still reads it)
controls.size_matched: another body's command as a change from its own pose applied to this body's pose, the eyes' row as its asked eye turn applied to this body's eyes (lem/model/efference.py size_matched_other_order), with this body's latent and pose (controllability's recorded-only shadow gate reads it)

synergy.command_size_scope: formed proposals; following_by_author grades full executed tenures

liveness.varying_rule: the share of a layer's units whose output range over the window's samples exceeds one bf16 step at the unit's own size and the widest output below the -3 line; not_varying lists layers under half

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

scale.token_between_bodies: window mean over steps of the spread of the raw vestibular token between the bodies, root mean square over its 192 numbers (0 = every body gets the same token; the five other senses read 0.15-0.53 in the memory's saved events)
scale.token_change: window mean of the root mean square change per number of each body's raw vestibular token from one moment to the next, over pairs of real moments (0 = it never changes)
scale.bias_spread: the spread across its 192 numbers of the encoder's last-layer bias at the window's end: what the registry's LayerNorm divides the weights' part by (74,425 before the repair, 9.2-18.3 right after it: 18.17 on H84)
scale.weight_rms: root mean square of the encoder's last-layer weight at the window's end
scale.switch: the load's switch: the step, what it divided by, and the probe's token change
scale.balance_probe: how much of the body's balance state the token carries (BalanceProbe): a linear read, from each body's token change, of that body's change of head tilt (where gravity pulls in the head) and of trunk roll (its sine and cosine), each change taken from the body's own mean over its report, fitted on the even-numbered bodies and scored on the odd ones and the other way round, over the last 10 reports; r2 1 = every change predicted exactly, 0 = no better than predicting no change, below 0 = worse; r2_shuffled = the same read with each body's token paired with another body's state (the control); a dead token scores 0; within_body_turn_deg = how far the bodies turned within a report (root mean square, degrees): the size of what is read
scale.revival_ceiling: the next-moment lesson's ceiling on this sense while its weight is at its cap (REVIVAL_CEILING): live and replay, the steps it applied to (the weight at its cap), the steps it held the term down, and the mean factor the weight was multiplied by on those (1 = not held down; 0.1 = the term would have been 10 times the other senses' mean); the ceiling judges the term with the sense's lesson weight in it
scale.encoder_precision: the precision the encoder computes in: float32 with rescale_restart_fp32, else the run's
scale.lesson_weight: the sense's own weight in the next-moment lesson (--vestibular-lesson-weight; 1 = counted like every other sense), live and in replay; next_frame_norm's shares read it

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 19.6 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

gate_definitions.reading: one per graded command (the bodies' commands latched on one model step are graded together when the next commands appear): the mean, over the bodies measured on it, of the agreement with this body's own expectation minus the agreement with the control's expectation; -2 to +2, 0 = the body head's expectation matched what the body did no better with this body's command than with the control command
gate_definitions.gate: the evidence gate in force. Its control is the ABSOLUTE one: the body head's expectation from another body's command as it stands, targets chosen for that body's pose (control_mean; difference_mean = agreement minus it). Over its last 32 readings it opens when their mean is above 3 of their standard errors and, once open, shuts when the mean is under 1; while it is shut the controllability weight in the goal ranking is 0. gate_mean and gate_standard_error are that mean and standard error, gate_readings_above_zero the readings above 0 (half of the readings held = no advantage), gate_readings_held how many of the 32 readings exist (the gate stays shut until all do)
gate_definitions.shadow_gate: recorded only: the same rule on the same graded commands and the same measured bodies, with the SIZE-MATCHED control in place of the absolute one: the body head's expectation from another body's asked moves and turns, measured from that body's own pose and applied to this body's pose (size_matched_control_mean; size_matched_difference_mean = agreement minus it). shadow_gate_mean, shadow_gate_standard_error, shadow_gate_readings_above_zero, shadow_gate_readings_held and shadow_gate_open read as the gate's. This block is its one reader: the controllability weight, the goal ranking and every loss read the gate in force
gate_definitions.counts: per report window, in graded commands. gate_commands / shadow_gate_commands: the commands at which that gate took a reading; gate_open_commands / shadow_gate_open_commands: those after whose reading it stood open. gates_same_commands: the commands at which both gates took a reading, of which gates_both_open_commands had both open, gate_only_open_commands the gate in force open and the shadow gate shut, shadow_gate_only_open_commands the reverse; on the rest both were shut

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

prediction_audit.scale: 0 = persistence; 1 = exact next token; negative = worse than persistence
prediction_audit.sensitivity_scale: ||pred(real order) - pred(another body's order)|| / ||pred(real order) - current token||: 0 = the order does not move the prediction, 1 = it moves it as far as the whole predicted change
prediction_audit.limitation: Encoded senses, not physical skill or held-out action-choice proof
prediction_audit.sampled_at: model steps whose number is a multiple of 20. The trainer latches a new command on model steps that are multiples of --motor-hold, and the command graded at model step s is the one sent during model step s-1, so with --motor-hold 5 every graded transition is the 5th and last model step of its command's hold, when the same command already fills the four newest context slots

arms.shuffled: another body's ABSOLUTE command (the absolute roll): body b's 26 x 9 command replaced by body b-1's as it stands (body 0 takes the last body's). Its targets are positions and orientations chosen for the other body's pose, so the change it asks of this body is larger than any body was asked, and a prediction that grows with the asked change errs more with it without using the command's effect. The original control: its keys keep their names and meaning (shuffled_action_mse, matched_prediction_mse, improvement_over_shuffled, sensitivity) and it is kept beside the size-matched arm for one segment, the first on this code, so the two can be read across; then it is retired
arms.size_matched: another body's command, SIZE-MATCHED: body b-1's command taken as a change from body b-1's own pose and applied to body b's pose (lem/model/contact_head.shuffled_order, the contact head's control: position = this pose + (other target - other pose) in cm, orientation = (other target x inverse of the other pose) x this pose, radius and strength as they stand) and the eyes' row as the other body's asked eye turn (its eye command minus its eyes' azimuth and elevation at the start) added to this body's eyes' angles (lem/model/efference.size_matched_other_order). Every asked move and turn is exactly the other body's, so a prediction that only grows with the size of the asked change scores the same with either command
arms.shifted_own: this body's OWN command shifted: each of its 26 x 9 numbers plus Gaussian noise of one standard deviation of that column over the executed-command stream (an exponential average over 2,000 model steps of every body's executed command, each quaternion taken with w >= 0, kept in LemLite._command_spread and saved in the episode companion; no gradient, never trained), each quaternion then rescaled to length 1. The noise of model step s comes from a generator seeded with the run's seed and s. Read only after 200 model steps of stream

prediction_audit.readings: improvement_over_<arm> = 1 - (sum of own-command prediction errors) / (sum of that arm's prediction errors) over the same transitions: 0 = the arm's command predicts as well as the own command, 1 = the own command predicts exactly where the arm's command does not, below 0 = the arm's command predicts better. sensitivity_<arm> = ||pred(own) - pred(arm)|| / ||pred(own) - current token||: 0 = the arm's command leaves the prediction where it was, 1 = it moves the prediction as far as the whole predicted change

scale.ratio: each body's token movement per unit of its own posture movement over the 300-s window (the token's and the posture's standard deviation over time, mean over numbers): 0 = the token does not move with the posture; the line = the live bodies' level
scale.ratio_posture_only: the same with the velocity and capacity inputs held at their window mean: the part that answers the posture (the lesson pushes this one)
scale.engaged: the bodies the lesson pushes: engaged when read under DEAF, released at LINE
scale.pushed_ever: the bodies the lesson has pushed since the start (the hold acts on these only)
scale.fatigue_line: the hold's line in force: the median fatigue answer on the posture-only rows of the judged bodies the lesson never pushed, read at the start and again each window (300 s) (null: no live body at the start, the hold does not act)
scale.fatigue_line_step: the step the hold's line was last read
scale.fatigue_answer_posture_only: the fatigue answer on the posture-only rows: every pushed body's at every step (the hold's reading), every moving body's on a gauge step
scale.hold_share_since_gauge: per body, the share of the steps since the last gauge step in which the hold pulled it down
scale.hold_any_share_since_gauge: the share of the steps since the last gauge step in which the hold acted on any body
scale.held: the pushed bodies whose posture-only fatigue answer read over the fatigue line (the hold pulled them down this step)
scale.hold: 1/2 x the sum of the held bodies' squared log excess over the fatigue line / bodies
scale.shortfall: ln line - ln ratio for a pushed body (0 at or above the line, or not engaged)
scale.jitter_share: the token's share of its own variance that changes between consecutive samples (0 = smooth, 1 = consecutive tokens unrelated)
scale.posture_jitter_share: the same share of the posture itself
scale.content: the version-4 posture content (a ten-block decoder's R2 at the penalty control_lambda): 0 = the token says nothing about the posture, 1 = exactly
scale.content_gain_matched: the same with the token's gain since the start divided out: a pure gain reads the start's content, movement without posture information less
scale.content_control: the same with the tokens shifted 150 s against the posture
scale.fatigue_answer: the token's mean change per number when every fatigue input moves by fatigue_step, over its response: 0 = the token ignores fatigue
scale.held_out: the window read through the encoder saved one window earlier (movement that encoder never trained on): its ratio and gain-matched content
scale.lesson_pace: each body's first-order change of ln ratio per update from the lesson's own step
scale.attributed: the lesson's summed first-order change of each body's ln ratio since the start
scale.start: the readings of the first full window, before the lesson's first update
scale.spread: the token's standard deviation over the 300-s window per number, mean over numbers: 0 = one token every moment
scale.posture_spread: the posture's standard deviation over the window per number, mean over numbers
scale.below_line: bodies pushed at the last step
scale.no_movement: bodies whose posture numbers did not change over the window (no ratio)
scale.applied: the lesson's gradient added after the clip, as a share of each encoder tensor's running gradient size; step_lr: the lesson's step per weight in learning rates

controls.shuffled: another body's ABSOLUTE command with this body's latent and pose: its targets as they stand, chosen for the other body's pose (the original control; kept beside size_matched for one segment, the first on this code, then retired; controllability's evidence gate in force still reads it)
controls.size_matched: another body's command as a change from its own pose applied to this body's pose, the eyes' row as its asked eye turn applied to this body's eyes (lem/model/efference.py size_matched_other_order), with this body's latent and pose (controllability's recorded-only shadow gate reads it)

synergy.command_size_scope: formed proposals; following_by_author grades full executed tenures

liveness.varying_rule: the share of a layer's units whose output range over the window's samples exceeds one bf16 step at the unit's own size and the widest output below the -3 line; not_varying lists layers under half

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

scale.token_between_bodies: window mean over steps of the spread of the raw vestibular token between the bodies, root mean square over its 192 numbers (0 = every body gets the same token; the five other senses read 0.15-0.53 in the memory's saved events)
scale.token_change: window mean of the root mean square change per number of each body's raw vestibular token from one moment to the next, over pairs of real moments (0 = it never changes)
scale.bias_spread: the spread across its 192 numbers of the encoder's last-layer bias at the window's end: what the registry's LayerNorm divides the weights' part by (74,425 before the repair, 9.2-18.3 right after it: 18.17 on H84)
scale.weight_rms: root mean square of the encoder's last-layer weight at the window's end
scale.switch: the load's switch: the step, what it divided by, and the probe's token change
scale.balance_probe: how much of the body's balance state the token carries (BalanceProbe): a linear read, from each body's token change, of that body's change of head tilt (where gravity pulls in the head) and of trunk roll (its sine and cosine), each change taken from the body's own mean over its report, fitted on the even-numbered bodies and scored on the odd ones and the other way round, over the last 10 reports; r2 1 = every change predicted exactly, 0 = no better than predicting no change, below 0 = worse; r2_shuffled = the same read with each body's token paired with another body's state (the control); a dead token scores 0; within_body_turn_deg = how far the bodies turned within a report (root mean square, degrees): the size of what is read
scale.revival_ceiling: the next-moment lesson's ceiling on this sense while its weight is at its cap (REVIVAL_CEILING): live and replay, the steps it applied to (the weight at its cap), the steps it held the term down, and the mean factor the weight was multiplied by on those (1 = not held down; 0.1 = the term would have been 10 times the other senses' mean); the ceiling judges the term with the sense's lesson weight in it
scale.encoder_precision: the precision the encoder computes in: float32 with rescale_restart_fp32, else the run's
scale.lesson_weight: the sense's own weight in the next-moment lesson (--vestibular-lesson-weight; 1 = counted like every other sense), live and in replay; next_frame_norm's shares read it

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 19.4 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

gate_definitions.reading: one per graded command (the bodies' commands latched on one model step are graded together when the next commands appear): the mean, over the bodies measured on it, of the agreement with this body's own expectation minus the agreement with the control's expectation; -2 to +2, 0 = the body head's expectation matched what the body did no better with this body's command than with the control command
gate_definitions.gate: the evidence gate in force. Its control is the ABSOLUTE one: the body head's expectation from another body's command as it stands, targets chosen for that body's pose (control_mean; difference_mean = agreement minus it). Over its last 32 readings it opens when their mean is above 3 of their standard errors and, once open, shuts when the mean is under 1; while it is shut the controllability weight in the goal ranking is 0. gate_mean and gate_standard_error are that mean and standard error, gate_readings_above_zero the readings above 0 (half of the readings held = no advantage), gate_readings_held how many of the 32 readings exist (the gate stays shut until all do)
gate_definitions.shadow_gate: recorded only: the same rule on the same graded commands and the same measured bodies, with the SIZE-MATCHED control in place of the absolute one: the body head's expectation from another body's asked moves and turns, measured from that body's own pose and applied to this body's pose (size_matched_control_mean; size_matched_difference_mean = agreement minus it). shadow_gate_mean, shadow_gate_standard_error, shadow_gate_readings_above_zero, shadow_gate_readings_held and shadow_gate_open read as the gate's. This block is its one reader: the controllability weight, the goal ranking and every loss read the gate in force
gate_definitions.counts: per report window, in graded commands. gate_commands / shadow_gate_commands: the commands at which that gate took a reading; gate_open_commands / shadow_gate_open_commands: those after whose reading it stood open. gates_same_commands: the commands at which both gates took a reading, of which gates_both_open_commands had both open, gate_only_open_commands the gate in force open and the shadow gate shut, shadow_gate_only_open_commands the reverse; on the rest both were shut

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31
